details.cardSet: EX Crossover Set "THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS"
details.effect: [fanfare] Select a Cool follower in your cemetery not named Koume Shirasaka [Haunted Gown] that costs 3 or less and, if there are at least 3 Cool followers on your field, summon it. [act] [cost01], Lesson (1), [engage]: Search your deck for a Last Daylight, put it into your EX area, then shuffle. It costs 2 less to play this turn.

issues: The activated ability should grant the cost reduction to the card put into the EX area, not use a standalone `playCostReduction` on this card. Encode the search as `tutorFromDeck` with `filter: { "identityName": "Last Daylight" }`, `to: "exArea"`, `playCostReduction: 2`, then shuffle.

The activated ability cost for Lesson (1) is encoded with unsupported/wrong cost fields. Change it to use the implemented activated cost form for banishing from EX area, e.g. `cost: { "pp": 1, "banishFromExArea": { "filter": { "trait": "Magical Item" }, "count": 1 }, "engage": true }`.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] Bury another follower: Select an enemy follower on the field. Destroy it, give your leader [defense]+1, bury the top 2 cards of your deck, and draw a card.

issues: The fanfare's 'Bury another follower' is encoded as an ability `cost`, but fanfare abilities do not use `cost`. Encode it inside the effect with `optionalCost` or an equivalent sequence that buries another follower from your field before the rest of the fanfare resolves.

details.effect: [fanfare] Select up to 2 Vampire cards that cost a total of 6 or less in your cemetery and put them into your EX area. They cost 0 play points to play this turn. [act] [engage]: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it damage equal to the number of Vampire cards on your field.

issues: The fanfare should select up to 2 Vampire cards in your cemetery with total cost 6 or less and put them into your EX area; `tutorFromCemetery` only gets one card and does not enforce up to 2 / total cost 6. Encode an effect that moves up to 2 matching cards with max total cost 6 to EX area.
The fanfare is missing 'They cost 0 play points to play this turn.' After moving the selected cards to EX area, those cards should receive play cost reduction so their cost becomes 0 this turn.
